shots.vo_line: Wonder why I chew everything at 3am?
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gnaws slowly at the plastic wrap of the water bottles, head tugging gently, while the woman sleeps still under the duvet and moonlight glows softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I'm not being a pain. My mouth hurts, and no one helps me.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat looks into the camera with pleading eyes, blinks slowly and touches her paw to her mouth, ears drooping slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: In the wild, I'd spend hours hunting and chewing prey.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gnaws the meat on the bone with steady jaw movements, eyes narrowed, as sunbeams shimmer and leaves sway gently. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It keeps my teeth clean, my stress low and my instincts sharp.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat bites into the meat with her side teeth, jaw working slowly, eyes fierce, while ferns sway softly around her. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: But indoors, I get soft food and biscuits, so nothing works on my teeth.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits glumly, sighs and lowers her head slightly, glancing at the bowl without moving towards it; the toy mouse stays still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And the dental treats you bought? Gone in two seconds. They never touch the plaque.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat raises one eyebrow further and looks at the treats, unimpressed, then slowly turns her eyes away, ears twitching. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: So with nothing working on them, plaque and bacteria build silently on my teeth.
shots.motion_prompt: Macro shot: the swollen red gums tremble slightly and the plaque-crusted teeth glisten under the light as the jaw quivers. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's why 80% of cats have dental disease before age two.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds her mouth open in shock, jaw trembling slightly, saliva strings stretching slowly, eyes wide. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: What I need is something that works on my teeth all day,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat looks up at the tub with curiosity, tilts her head slowly and twitches her whiskers. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.
The cat turns her face away and pushes gently at the toothbrush with her raised paw, while the hand slowly pulls the brush back. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: That's why I love Meow Mouth. It's a powder on my dinner,
shots.motion_prompt: The scoop tips slowly and powder falls gently onto the wet food while the cat leans in, whiskers twitching. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: made with brewer's yeast and a bacon flavour, so I clear my bowl every time.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats happily with eyes closed, head moving gently as she chews. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I digest it, and it comes back out through my saliva,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly licks her lips, eyes half closing with pleasure, as a faint shimmer of golden sparkles drifts around her mouth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: so the zinc and plant enzymes work on the plaque round the clock.
shots.motion_prompt: Macro shot: a glistening wave of golden saliva flows slowly over the teeth and flakes of plaque lift off and drift away, with a slight jaw tremble. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: My teeth stop rotting. I become calm,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat lies on her back with a peaceful smile, chest rising and falling slowly, paws twitching gently, as the warm glow shimmers softly. Static camera.
The hands gently stroke the curled-up cat, who purrs with eyes closed, chin lifting slightly, her side rising and falling slowly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Thousands of responsible cat owners have already switched. Now it's your turn.
shots.motion_prompt: The kitten takes a few small, slow steps towards the camera, smiling, and the crowd of cats behind follows at the same gentle pace as petals drift down. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Right now, it's buy two, get one free. Join them.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat smiles at the camera and blinks slowly as the star-shaped sparkle twinkles on her fang. Slow camera push-in.
